results.summary: Java 21 coding standards review failed for sample-java-code due to 2 Critical prohibited-pattern violations plus package, method naming, DI interface, and null-safety issues.

findings.title: Field injection with @Autowired is used in a Java test class
findings.description: The standards prohibit @Autowired field injection in all .java files. The MockMvc dependency is injected into a mutable field instead of constructor injection or another standards-compliant test setup.
findings.suggestedFix: Use constructor injection for the test dependency, or a Spring test setup that avoids field injection and keeps injected dependencies final where possible.

findings.title: DI-managed service is directly instantiated in test code
findings.description: GreetingService is annotated with @Service in production code, but the test creates it with new GreetingService(). The standards prohibit direct new XxxService() instantiation for DI-managed beans in all .java files.
findings.evidence: private final GreetingService greetingService = new GreetingService();
findings.suggestedFix: Inject GreetingService through Spring in a focused test context, or remove @Service from the class only if it is intentionally not DI-managed. Keep the production and test construction model consistent.

findings.title: Package namespace does not match the mandated base package
findings.description: The Java standards review context defines the migrated application base package as com.skishop, but the target uses com.codexskishop.sample. This creates a project-wide namespace inconsistency.
findings.suggestedFix: Move the sample application packages and Maven groupId under the required base namespace, for example com.skishop.sample, if this target is expected to comply with the repository Java standards.

findings.title: Controller method name is not verb-first
findings.description: The method name health() is camelCase but not verb-first. The standards require method names to be camelCase and verb-first.
findings.suggestedFix: Rename the method to a verb-first name such as getHealth() or checkHealth(). The endpoint path can remain /api/health.

findings.title: Service has no corresponding interface and controller depends on concrete service
findings.description: The DI checklist requires all Service and Repository classes to have corresponding interfaces. GreetingController injects the concrete GreetingService class directly, and no GreetingService interface is present in the reviewed target.
findings.evidence:
private final GreetingService greetingService;

public GreetingController(GreetingService greetingService) {
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce a service interface such as GreetingServicePort or GreetingUseCase, have GreetingService implement it, and inject the interface into the controller.

findings.title: Public service method accepts a nullable parameter without an explicit null-safety contract
findings.description: GreetingService.greet(String name) handles null indirectly through normalizeName, but the public API does not annotate or validate the parameter with a clear null-safety contract. The standards require @Nullable/@NonNull where ambiguity exists.
findings.evidence:
public GreetingResponse greet(String name) {
  String normalizedName = normalizeName(name);
findings.suggestedFix: Add an explicit contract, for example @NonNull plus Objects.requireNonNull, or document and annotate nullable input intentionally with @Nullable and keep the behavior tested.

findings.title: Spring Boot version does not match the agent's Spring Boot 3.2.x standard
findings.description: The review agent definition is scoped to Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.2.x, but the target POM uses Spring Boot 3.5.8. This may be intentional for the sample project, but it deviates from the stated standard.
findings.suggestedFix: Align the parent version with the required Spring Boot 3.2.x baseline, or document an approved exception for this target.

escalations.description: Confirm whether sample-java-code is required to follow the migration base package com.skishop and Spring Boot 3.2.x baseline, because the target name and current package suggest it may be a deliberately isolated sample project.

designDeviations.description: The target uses package/group namespace com.codexskishop.sample instead of the stated base package com.skishop.
The target POM uses Spring Boot 3.5.8 instead of the stated Spring Boot 3.2.x baseline.

# Source Code Review Report: Java 21 Coding Standards Review

## Summary
- **Review Target**: sample-java-code
- **Verdict**: ❌ Fail
- **Issue Count**: Critical: 2 / High: 4 / Medium: 1 / Low: 0

## Prohibited Pattern Detection Results
| # | Pattern | Count | Target File | Line # |
|---|---------|-------|-------------|--------|
| 1 | @Autowired field injection | 1 | sample-java-code/src/test/java/com/codexskishop/sample/api/GreetingControllerTest.java | 21 |
| 2 | new XxxService() direct instantiation | 1 | sample-java-code/src/test/java/com/codexskishop/sample/service/GreetingServiceTest.java | 10 |

## Incomplete / Shortcut Implementation Detection Results
| # | Type | Detection | Target File | Line # | Details |
|---|------|-----------|-------------|--------|---------|
| - | - | None detected in reviewed Java source | - | - | No TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX, UnsupportedOperationException, placeholder Not implemented exceptions, or production Mock/Fake/Stub/Dummy classes were detected. |

## Naming Convention Check Results
| File | Violation Location | Current Name | Recommended Name |
|------|-------------------|-------------|-----------------|
| sample-java-code/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/sample/SampleJavaCodeApplication.java | package declaration | com.codexskishop.sample | com.skishop.sample, if this target must follow the migration base package |
| sample-java-code/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/sample/api/GreetingController.java | method line 35 | health() | getHealth() or checkHealth() |

## Issues
| # | Severity | Category | Target File | Line # | Issue Description | Fix Example |
|---|----------|----------|-------------|--------|-------------------|-------------|
| 1 | Critical | Prohibited Pattern | sample-java-code/src/test/java/com/codexskishop/sample/api/GreetingControllerTest.java | 21 | @Autowired field injection is prohibited in all .java files. | Avoid field injection; use constructor injection or another standards-compliant test setup. |
| 2 | Critical | Prohibited Pattern | sample-java-code/src/test/java/com/codexskishop/sample/service/GreetingServiceTest.java | 10 | GreetingService is a DI-managed @Service but is directly instantiated with new GreetingService(). | Inject the service through Spring or make construction policy consistent. |
| 3 | High | Naming Conventions | sample-java-code/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/sample/SampleJavaCodeApplication.java | 1 | Package namespace does not match the stated com.skishop base package. | Move packages/groupId under com.skishop.* or document an approved exception. |
| 4 | High | Naming Conventions | sample-java-code/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/sample/api/GreetingController.java | 35 | Method name health() is not verb-first. | Rename to getHealth() or checkHealth(). |
| 5 | High | DI Pattern Quality | sample-java-code/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/sample/api/GreetingController.java | 23 | Service has no corresponding interface and controller injects the concrete class. | Add a service interface and inject that interface. |
| 6 | High | Null Safety | sample-java-code/src/main/java/com/codexskishop/sample/service/GreetingService.java | 19 | Public service method accepts String name without explicit @Nullable/@NonNull contract. | Annotate the parameter or enforce non-null with a clear contract. |
| 7 | Medium | Spring Boot Standard | sample-java-code/pom.xml | 10 | POM uses Spring Boot 3.5.8 while the agent standard says Spring Boot 3.2.x. | Align to 3.2.x or document an approved exception. |

## Scorecard
| Evaluation Item | Score (1-5) | Notes |
|----------------|-------------|-------|
| Naming Conventions | 3/5 | Mostly clean class/record naming, but package baseline and verb-first method naming violations remain. |
| Java 21 Feature Adoption | 5/5 | DTOs are records and tests use text blocks where useful; no obvious legacy Java construct requiring replacement was found. |
| Prohibited Pattern Compliance | 1/5 | Critical @Autowired field injection and direct new XxxService() instantiation were detected. |
| DI Pattern Quality | 2/5 | Constructor injection is used in production controller, but service interface segregation is missing and tests bypass DI. |
| Null Safety | 3/5 | No collection null returns or Optional misuse found, but public service null contract is ambiguous. |
| **Total Score** | **14/25** | Fail because Critical prohibited patterns are present. |

## Escalation Items (Requires Human Judgment)
- Confirm whether sample-java-code must follow the migration base package com.skishop and Spring Boot 3.2.x baseline, or whether this sample target has an approved exception.
